brand.name: NØX
brand.tagline: Premium products · Instant delivery · Trusted service
brand.about: **NØX** is a premium store and community. We focus on fast delivery, fair prices and support that actually answers – every order is handled personally by our team through a private ticket.

shop.refundPolicy: Refunds are only possible if we can't deliver your product. Once delivery has started, all sales are final.

paymentMethods.name: PaysafeCard

paymentMethods.name: PayPal

panel.title: Support Center
panel.description: Need help, want to buy something or have a question? Pick a category below – we'll open a **private channel** that only you and our team can see.
rules: Describe your request in as much detail as possible
Don't ping the staff – they're notified automatically
Tickets without a reply are closed automatically

snippets.name: 👋 Greeting
snippets.content: Hi {user}! My name is {staff} and I'll be handling your ticket. Give me a moment to look into it.

snippets.name: 💰 Order quote
snippets.content: Thanks for your order, {user}! {staff} will send you the final price and payment details right here in a moment.

snippets.name: 💳 Payment received
snippets.content: Payment received, {user} – thank you! 🎉 We're processing your order now and will deliver it right here.

snippets.name: 📦 Delivered
snippets.content: Your order has been delivered, {user}! 💜 If everything works, we'd love a vouch in the vouches channel – it really helps us.

snippets.name: 🔍 Ask for details
snippets.content: {user}, we need a bit more information. Please describe exactly what happened and attach screenshots if you can.

snippets.name: ⏳ Please wait
snippets.content: I've passed this on, {user}. We'll get back to you as soon as possible – thanks for your patience!

snippets.name: ✅ Resolved
snippets.content: Looks like everything is sorted 🎉 If you need anything else, just write here – otherwise we'll close the ticket.

snippets.name: 📜 Rules
snippets.content: {user}, please make sure you've read the rules of **{server}**. Thank you!
